description: Ghana - High Resolution Wind Resource is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Resource assessments, Wind", published or maintained by National Renewable Energy Laboratory (World Bank Group). This shapefile containing 50 meter height data has been validated by NREL and wind energy meteorological consultants. However, the data is not suitable for micro-siting potential development projects. The shapefile was generated from a raster dataset with a 200 m resolution,0 in a UTM zone 12, datum WGS 84 projection system. Coverage: Ghana. It has 3 files in GeoJSON, SHP ZIP, PDF. The portal files it under Resource assessments, Wind. The portal gives 2003 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
